notes: kb/Work PB1086/PB989/PB2103/PB4455: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.4 'if the externalized name of the function prototype is the externalized name of a function definition specified previously in the same compilation group' -> OK 12.3.8.4 11) a)). NOTE 2: literal-5 is the externalized name. Verified, all three arms, in ONE place - RepositoryResolver.ResolveFunction (determination D-R3, DESIGN-external-repository 8.3): step 1 finds, by EXTERNALIZED name, a) a definition specified BEFORE the referencing element (GroupRepositoryProvider), b) else a function prototype definition of the group, c) else MetadataRepositoryProvider.Function, the first entry of that externalized name in the external repository (the --repository directories, then the --reference assemblies; DOC-A.1-66); step 2, when step 1 misses and the specifier is legal by SR10's word alternative or 8.4.6.7, takes the function the WORD names (group, then repository entries carry the word beside the externalized name); step 3 warns COBOL2969 (REPO-13) when step 1 hit and a DIFFERENT function carries the word, the externalized name winning (GnuCOBOL 3.2.0's answer). A definition that follows the REPOSITORY entry with no prototype ahead and no entry is REPO-1 (COBOL5962, SR10). Witnesses: a) pb974_repository_as_phrase, pb989_function_externalized_name_wins; b) udf_prototype, UdfInvocationTests.PrototypeOnly_NoInGroupDefinition_Binds, pb989_function_prototype_externalized_name, pb2103_function_prototype_ignores_entry (the repository's entry is ignored once the group's prototype answers) and AGroupFunctionPrototype_IgnoresAnEntryBuiltWithoutSignatures; c) AFunctionPrototypeCompiledAlone_PublishesItsSignature_UnlessUpdateIsOff (a function prototype compiled alone answers a later FUNCTION specifier through the repository), pb2103_function_word_in_repository and pb2103_repo13_across_repository (steps 2 and 3 over the repository); nothing answering is negative pb989-function-definition-follows-the-specifier and AFunctionSpecifierTheGroupDoesNotAnswer_ReportsTheEntrysFault. SR11's self-entry-with-AS is UserFunctionsOf's (SR-12.3.8.3-11). Re-probed 2026-11-03 on the PB1086 branch (kb/Work PB1086): the note's own sr10.cob (REPOSITORY.
